title: HELIX Terminology: Hold Type
description: Standard types of holds/restrictions placed on student records.

codes.definition: Prevents the student from registering for courses
Unpaid balance or financial obligation. May prevent registration, transcript release, or graduation.
Academic deficiency (GPA, SAP, etc.). May require advising clearance before registration.
Conduct or disciplinary action pending or in effect
Prevents degree conferral (e.g., outstanding requirements, exit interview)
Missing immunization records, health insurance verification, or other health requirements
Missing admissions documents (final transcript, test scores, etc.)
Visa compliance, SEVIS reporting, or international student office clearance
